name: Customer Support & Incident Service Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for customer support and service management, covering ticket intake, case triage, tier 1-3 assignment, SLA response/resolution tracking, escalation matrices, customer notifications, and CSAT feedback.

checklists.name: Customer Support & SLA Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for ticket intake, triage, SLA tracking, resolution verification, and CSAT collection.

items.statement: Support tickets are assigned severity levels (P1-P4) based on impacted user count and business operational effect.
Response time SLAs (e.g. 15 mins for P1, 2 hours for P2) are tracked continuously.
P1 critical incidents initiate war-room incident bridges and notify Duty Operations Managers.
Ticket resolution notes document root cause and steps taken before requesting customer closure confirmation.
CSAT (Customer Satisfaction) feedback survey is triggered automatically upon case closure.

reviewGates.name: Customer Support Operations Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Customer Support Operations Manager confirms that SLA response rates, escalation triggers, and CSAT scores meet operational standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the support documentation confirm SLA adherence and resolution quality?
